title: Nazi memorabilia at Paperclip facilities

tellings.quote: Swastikas and Nazi memorabilia were reportedly on open display in some of these facilities.

plain: In the late 1940s, swastikas and other Nazi memorabilia were reportedly on open display in some of the facilities used by Operation Paperclip, the US programme that brought German scientists to work on American rockets, at sites such as Fort Bliss and White Sands. Michels tells this himself, as something reported, without naming a source, to show how openly those scientists brought their past with them.
